questions.question: What exact phone number should I call for the University IT Service Desk?

passages.text:
Service Desk Guidance — Vpn

Users must authenticate to the VPN with their university account. If the VPN client repeatedly fails, the user should record the error message before contacting support. A user should disconnect and reconnect the VPN after changing their university password. The university VPN provides remote access to selected internal services.
